### 1. Scene
A tray meal with a chicken-and-shredded-vegetable salad, a toasted filled sandwich, a cookie, and water. All three food plates appear to belong to this meal.

### 2. Vessels
Estimated plate sizes and areas:
- Salad plate: **23 cm**, area **415 cm²**
- Sandwich plate: **20 cm**, area **314 cm²**
- Cookie plate: **18 cm**, area **254 cm²**

### 3. Items
Visible foods are cooked chicken pieces; shredded cabbage/lettuce; carrot, tomato and cucumber; mushrooms; dark dressing; a toasted sandwich with apparent meat, cheese and tomato filling; and a chocolate-chip cookie. The sandwich’s cooking fat is included in its energy estimate.

### 4–6. Coverage, volume and weight
Percentages refer to each item’s own plate. For the salad, overlapping ingredients are assigned separate footprint shares to avoid double-counting area.

| Item | Plate area covered | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Estimated grams |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Cooked chicken | 23% | 95 × 1.3 = 124 ml | 0.95 | 118 |
| Shredded cabbage/lettuce | 40% | 166 × 2.0 = 332 ml | 0.20 | 66 |
| Carrot, tomato, cucumber | 15% | 62 × 1.2 = 74 ml | 0.60 | 45 |
| Cooked mushrooms | 6% | 25 × 1.2 = 30 ml | 0.60 | 18 |
| Dark dressing | 3% | 12 × 0.6 = 7 ml | 1.00 | 7 |
| Toasted filled sandwich | 55% | 173 × 2.1 = 363 ml | 0.50* | 181 |
| Chocolate-chip cookie | 17% | 43 × 0.9 = 39 ml | 0.90 | 35 |

*The sandwich uses a composite density reflecting porous bread and denser filling.*

Coverage totals: **87% of the salad plate**, **55% of the sandwich plate**, and **17% of the cookie plate**.

### 7. Energy
| Item | kcal/100 g | Estimated kcal |
|---|---:|---:|
| Cooked chicken | 190 | 224 |
| Shredded cabbage/lettuce | 25 | 17 |
| Carrot, tomato, cucumber | 30 | 14 |
| Cooked mushrooms | 45 | 8 |
| Dark dressing | 180 | 13 |
| Toasted filled sandwich | 270 | 489 |
| Chocolate-chip cookie | 480 | 168 |

### 8. Sanity check
The estimate is **470 g of food and approximately 930 kcal**. This is plausible for a generously topped salad, a toasted sandwich and one medium cookie. Water contributes no calories and is excluded from food weight. Sandwich filling and dressing composition are the largest uncertainties.
